integrity: The included independent-enumeration code checks all third-agent permutations through eight houses; the general theorem is supported by an explicit combinatorial proof. External independent scientific audit has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Exactly three agents, two fixed reverse strict preference rankings and an arbitrary third strict ranking.
The exact probability conditions on the polarized pair, not on all three rankings being independent.
The growing-stock law assumes coherent nested inventories and independent atomless third-agent utilities.
No Pareto-efficiency statement, robustness to preference perturbations, or general-agent result is asserted.
Single-dipped impossibility is prior art; the contribution is a sharp converse in the polarized subdomain and exact joint envy and inventory laws.
An unindexed equivalent in house-allocation or permutation-pattern literature remains possible.
title: Polarized three-agent house allocation: an exact envy obstruction and stock law
